summary.content:
Today's selection covers 41 articles from 7 trusted sources, including 24 on Artificial Intelligence and 7 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: Anthropic is turning Claude Code’s auto mode on by default
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: Planned Amazon data center could become the biggest climate polluter in the U.S.
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights phishing, data breaches, malware
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from TechCrunch, The Verge, BBC Technology, SecurityWeek, NY Times Tech and others
• **Fresh Content**: 7 articles published in the last 24 hours
